title: The Person Closest to You
previousChoice: 1: Close the door (confirmed by the creator as the Ch.3 winner)

lines.text: Nora closed the door.
lines.sub: Nora closed the door.

lines.text: Good. Now bring me the photo. Come to the tower. Alone.
lines.sub: “Good. Now bring me the photo. Come to the tower. Alone.”

lines.text: Nora, wait. Look at the photo. On my camera.
lines.sub: “Nora, wait. Look at the photo… on my camera.”

lines.text: On Theo's screen, the girl in the yellow raincoat was gone. Echoes never show up on screens.
lines.sub: On Theo's screen, the girl in the yellow raincoat was gone. Echoes never show up on screens.

lines.text: I was never at the tower. She was.
lines.sub: “I was never at the tower. SHE was.”

lines.text: The radio sounds like you, because it is you. The other you.
lines.sub: “The radio sounds like you… because it IS you. The other you.”

lines.text: Do not trust the person closest to you. It never meant a friend. It meant herself.
lines.sub: “Do not trust the person closest to you.” It never meant a friend. It meant herself.

lines.text: And every warning came from him. My echo. Don't trust whoever is with you. He meant the radio.
lines.sub: “And every warning came from him. My Echo. ‘Don't trust whoever is with you.’ He meant the radio.”

lines.text: The boy they shut outside had been protecting them all along.
lines.sub: The boy they shut outside had been protecting them all along.

lines.text: If you won't come to me, I'll come to you.
lines.sub: “If you won't come to me… I'll come to you.”

lines.text: Theo! Come in!
lines.sub: “THEO! COME IN!”

lines.text: One invitation. That's all he ever needed.
lines.sub: One invitation. That's all he ever needed.

lines.text: We came out of the light together. We go back together.
lines.sub: “We came out of the light together. We go back together.”

lines.text: Take care of her.
lines.sub: “Take care of her.”

lines.text: Then the tower went dark. And every light in Harlow Point came back on.
lines.sub: Then the tower went dark. And every light in Harlow Point came back on.

lines.text: Nora. I'm proud of you. Look after Milo. Goodbye, sweetheart.
lines.sub: “Nora… I'm proud of you. Look after Milo. Goodbye, sweetheart.”

lines.text: Her father's last signal. Then, silence.
lines.sub: Her father's last signal. Then… silence.

lines.text: No more secrets.
lines.sub: “No more secrets.”

lines.text: No more secrets.
lines.sub: “No more secrets.”

lines.text: And for the first time in three years, Nora Vance trusted someone again.
lines.sub: And for the first time in three years, Nora Vance trusted someone again.

lines.text: That's the end of The Last Signal. What did you think? Drop your theory in the comments, and follow for a brand new story!
